lines.zh: 我在草地上小跑，翅膀扑棱扑棱。
lines.en: Trotting through the grass, flapping my little wings.

lines.zh: 一步一晃，脖子先往前探。
lines.en: Head first, waddling one step at a time.
Mind my tail, I can't walk fast.
Cluck, cluck, make room, coming through.

lines.zh: 我这两条腿短是短，够用。
lines.en: Short legs, but they get me there.

lines.zh: 草地上的虫子味道最好。
lines.en: Worms taste best on fresh green grass.

lines.zh: 我扑一下翅膀就能飘过去。
lines.en: One flap and I glide over the gap.

lines.zh: 谁把栅栏门关了？我绕一圈。
lines.en: Who shut the gate? I'll go around.

lines.zh: 走路要昂头，这样才像只鸡。
lines.en: Walk with your head high, like a proper chicken.
Every seed I step on is mine.

lines.zh: 慢点慢点，我羽毛要乱了。
lines.en: Easy, easy, my feathers are getting ruffled.
Warm dirt under the sun feels good on my feet.

lines.zh: 我走路带风，虽然只有一点。
lines.en: I stir up wind when I walk. A little.

lines.zh: 跟着我走，别掉队，小短腿们。
lines.en: Follow me, don't fall behind, short legs.

lines.zh: 我穿过篱笆的破洞，钻得过去。
lines.en: I squeeze through the hole in the fence.

lines.zh: 泥地上有我的脚印，像小树枝。
lines.en: My prints in the mud look like little twigs.
Cluck, today feels like an egg day.

lines.zh: 我啄一啄土，说不定有种子。
lines.en: A peck at the dirt might turn up a seed.
Preening my feathers, one by one.
Head tilted, watching the clouds drift.

lines.zh: 谁在那边撒谷子？我听见了。
lines.en: Someone scattering grain? I heard that.

lines.zh: 窝里的草得再铺厚一点。
lines.en: The nest needs a bit more straw.

lines.zh: 我蹲下歇会儿，就一会儿。
lines.en: Squatting for a rest. Just a short one.

lines.zh: 翅膀收好，不能显得邋遢。
lines.en: Wings folded neat. Can't look scruffy.

lines.zh: 这地方虫子不多，换个地儿。
lines.en: Not many bugs here. I'll try elsewhere.
A little burp. Cluck.
The wind puffs up all my feathers.

lines.zh: 我得数数我的小鸡，一二三。
lines.en: Counting my chicks. One, two, three.
Standing still gets boring too.

lines.zh: 刚才那颗种子，我还没咽下去。
lines.en: That seed is still sitting in my crop.

lines.zh: 我侧着头，听土里有没有虫。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen for bugs in the soil.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀张开又合上，散热。
lines.en: I spread my wings and fold them to cool off.
Is that seeds in your hand?
I'm staring at you. You're staring back.

lines.zh: 你个头真大，我不怕你，才怪。
lines.en: You're huge. I'm not scared. Mostly.

lines.zh: 蹲下来，让我看看你的手。
lines.en: Crouch down, let me see your hands.
There are grass seeds on your boots.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，是想看清楚你。
lines.en: My head's tilted so I can see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你走过的那片草地，我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the grass you just walked through.
Don't reach so fast, I scare easily.
Your shadow just swallowed me whole.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转半圈，看看另一边。
lines.en: I'll circle halfway and check your other side.
Are you taking me to the barn?
Do I know you? You look familiar.
Cluck! Who hit me!
I lost three feathers.
Ow ow ow, running!
Don't hit me, I'm just a chicken.
My wing's bent. Can't flap right.
Who did that? I'll remember you.
Hiding in the tall grass.
Cluck cluck, run, run.
This spot isn't safe anymore.
My eggs are still in the nest.
Seeds! I see seeds!
Scatter a few, just a few.

lines.zh: 我跟你走，只要你有那袋谷子。
lines.en: I'll follow you for that sack of grain.

lines.zh: 别晃手，我看不清哪颗最大。
lines.en: Stop waving, I can't tell which one's biggest.

lines.zh: 咯咯咯咯，我要那颗圆的。
lines.en: Cluck cluck, I want the round one.
Slow down, my legs are short.

lines.zh: 为了种子，我可以跑一整天。
lines.en: For seeds I could run all day.

lines.zh: 你兜里还有吗？我闻到味了。
lines.en: Got more in your pocket? I can smell it.
One bite first, then we talk.
Don't fob me off with wheat. I want seeds.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，一路啄到你家。
lines.en: I'll follow you, pecking all the way home.
I'll eat right out of your palm.
I'm flapping. That means I'm happy.

lines.zh: 这一小把，够我记你一天好。
lines.en: This little handful buys a day of goodwill.

lines.zh: 那把种子撒得真散，我慢慢啄。
lines.en: You scattered those seeds wide. I will peck them one by one.

lines.zh: 你蹲下了，我这才敢靠过去。
lines.en: You crouched down. Now I dare come closer.
Ow, you stepped on my toe.
One bump and my feathers go crooked.
I'm right here. Can't you see me?
Cluck! Back up a little!
Knocked aside again. I'm used to it.
Your leg feels like a wall.
Don't kick, I'm in the middle of laying.
You bumped me. Say something, at least.
I made way. You didn't.

lines.zh: 小鸡跟紧我，这里有大家伙。
lines.en: Chicks, stay close, there's a big one here.
Are you here to lay eggs too?

lines.zh: 我抖抖翅膀，你看我羽毛亮吗？
lines.en: I'm shaking my wings. Do they look fine?
Seeds first, then we talk.
I'll wait by the nest. Don't dawdle.

lines.zh: 我们会有很多小鸡，我数不过来。
lines.en: We'll have so many chicks I can't count them.
You cluck nicely. Do it again.
Your comb's crooked. Hold still.
This straw's soft enough. Here's fine.

lines.zh: 以后蛋归我孵，你守着门。
lines.en: I'll sit on the eggs. You watch the door.
Not so fast, I'm not ready yet.
I'm taking this seed.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我啄起来看看。
lines.en: Something on the ground. Let me peck it.
Oh, a whole grain of wheat.
I'm carrying it. Hands off.
This tastes wrong. Spitting it out.
Anything dropped is mine.
Swallowed it. Now it's gone.
Bit big. Stuck in my throat.
This goes to the little ones in the nest.

lines.zh: 捡到宝了，虽然只是颗籽。
lines.en: Found treasure. Well, a seed.
Who's moving over there? I saw that.
That thing is eyeing my eggs.

lines.zh: 我脖子伸长了，这是警告。
lines.en: Neck out means I'm warning you.
Stay away from the nest. I mean it.
A shadow just passed overhead.
One peck will tell me what it is.
Fox smell? I caught a whiff.
Chicks, get behind me.
I'm small, but I bite back.
There are eyes in the grass.

lines.zh: 我盯着你呢，别以为我没看见。
lines.en: I've got my eye on you.
One more step and I peck.

lines.zh: 我翅膀张开了，看着凶吧。
lines.en: Wings out. Do I look fierce?
Cluck cluck, get lost.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面，别跟着我转。
lines.en: I'll circle you. Stop turning.
Back off and I'll fold my wings.

lines.zh: 我脖子上的毛都竖起来了。
lines.en: The feathers on my neck are standing up.
You've crossed my line.
I'll count to three. Then you're done.
Don't touch that chick.
I've got your shoelace in my beak!
Jumping up to peck your knee.
That one was for my eggs.
Cluck! Does it sting?
And a scratch from my claws.
I can't beat you, but I won't stop.
Peck and run. That's the smart way.

lines.zh: 你裤脚破了，抱歉，不抱歉。
lines.en: Your cuff's torn. Sorry. Not sorry.
Wings to your face.
That's what you get for upsetting a chicken.
I popped out of the grass.
Sun's up. Time for me to appear.
Nice patch of grass. I'm moving in.
Cluck, new place. Let me look around.
Shaking off the last bits of shell.
Mother hen left me right here.
Bright enough here. I like it.

lines.zh: 有两只鸡先到了，我去打招呼。
lines.en: Two chickens got here first. I'll say hi.
My feathers are still damp.
Who's nearby? I need to learn the way.
Hot! My feathers are on fire!

lines.zh: 从高处掉下来，翅膀没用。
lines.en: Fell from a height. Wings didn't help.
Too deep, I can't float.
A bang, and I flew far.
Something just shot me!

lines.zh: 这疼得古怪，像有东西在扎。
lines.en: Strange pain, like needles inside.
Hungry. Can't even find a seed.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我羽毛全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning struck. Every feather's standing up.
Falling down into nothing.
